💥 EXTREME RAGDOLL SANDBOX

Welcome to Extreme Ragdoll Sandbox, the ultimate physics playground where chaos, destruction, and realistic ragdoll simulations come together! Experiment with powerful weapons, interact with intelligent dummies, unleash natural disasters, and discover endless ways to cause mayhem.

💥 ADVANCED RAGDOLL PHYSICS: Experience dynamic, realistic physics where every collision has an impact! Watch dummies lose balance, stumble, collapse, react to injuries, and attempt to regain control. Explore detailed limb reactions, realistic damage effects, and an interactive X-ray skeleton system.

🔫 INSANE WEAPONS & EXPLOSIVES: Choose from a massive arsenal of weapons, including assault rifles, sniper rifles, miniguns, katanas, rocket launchers, flamethrowers, and more! Unlock powerful equipment and discover new ways to experiment with physics.

🧱 DESTRUCTION WITHOUT LIMITS: Turn the entire environment into your playground! Demolish structures, launch objects into the air.
